---
title: "Supplementary Table X"
output: html_document
---

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(gtsummary)
library(openxlsx)
```

```{r load-data}
# Load cohorts
c1 <- read_csv("BEAT_BM_c1_merged_full_with_TEF.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(Cohort = "Waves 1–2 (Training)")

c2 <- read_csv("BEAT_BM_c2_merged_full_with_TEF.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(Cohort = "Waves 3–4 (Validation)")

# Combine cohorts
df <- bind_rows(c1, c2)

# Keep only patients included in modelling
df <- df %>%
  filter(response_induction %in% c("Refractory", "Complete Response"))
```

```{r prepare-data}
vars <- c(
  "age_dx",
  "sex",
  "response_induction",
  "wbc",
  "blasts_pb",
  "blasts_bm",
  "platelet",
  "hemoglobin",
  "eln_clean",
  "npm1",
  "flt3_itd",
  "DNMT3A",
  "IDH1",
  "IDH2",
  "runx1",
  "asxl1",
  "tp53"
)

vars <- vars[vars %in% colnames(df)]

baseline_df <- df %>%
  select(Cohort, all_of(vars)) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      any_of(c(
        "sex", "response_induction", "eln_clean",
        "npm1", "flt3_itd", "DNMT3A", "IDH1", "IDH2",
        "runx1", "asxl1", "tp53"
      )),
      as.factor
    )
  )
```

```{r generate-table}
tbl1 <- baseline_df %>%
  tbl_summary(
    by = Cohort,
    statistic = list(
      all_continuous() ~ "{median} ({p25}-{p75})",
      all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"
    ),
    missing = "no",
    label = list(
      age_dx ~ "Age at diagnosis",
      sex ~ "Sex",
      response_induction ~ "Induction response",
      wbc ~ "White blood cell count",
      blasts_pb ~ "Peripheral blood blasts (%)",
      blasts_bm ~ "Bone marrow blasts (%)",
      platelet ~ "Platelet count",
      hemoglobin ~ "Haemoglobin",
      eln_clean ~ "ELN risk category",
      npm1 ~ "NPM1 mutation",
      flt3_itd ~ "FLT3-ITD",
      DNMT3A ~ "DNMT3A mutation",
      IDH1 ~ "IDH1 mutation",
      IDH2 ~ "IDH2 mutation",
      runx1 ~ "RUNX1 mutation",
      asxl1 ~ "ASXL1 mutation",
      tp53 ~ "TP53 mutation"
    )
  )

tbl1
```

```{r export-excel}
table_x <- as_tibble(tbl1, col_labels = TRUE)

wb <- createWorkbook()
addWorksheet(wb, "Baseline Characteristics")

writeData(
  wb,
  sheet = "Baseline Characteristics",
  x = table_x
)

saveWorkbook(
  wb,
  "Supplementary_Table_X_Baseline_Cohort_Characteristics.xlsx",
  overwrite = TRUE
)

cat("Excel file written: Supplementary_Table_X_Baseline_Cohort_Characteristics.xlsx")
```
